sentences.en: The company is a producer and distributor of television programming.
sentences.zh: 1. 该公司是电视节目的制作商和发行商。

sentences.en: The producers of Spanish strawberries divert water from natural reserves.
sentences.zh: 2. 西班牙草莓生产商从自然储备中抽取水源。

sentences.en: Algeria is one of the largest oil producers in Africa.
sentences.zh: 3. 阿尔及利亚是非洲最大的石油生产国之一。

senses.zh: 生产者，制作人，制片人；生产商，制造商；（自然界的）生产者；（石油、天然气等的）生产国
